causal_treatment: learned B1 bidding on evaluated seat only
fixed_components: two opponent seats use frozen B0 bidding
all seats use frozen B0 declaration
all seats use frozen B0 discard
all seats use frozen B0 cardplay models

design.primary_local_metric: paired candidate-seat SkatZero evaluation reward delta

stages.name: SCREEN
stages.rule: if ci95_high < 0, stop for clear local regression; otherwise continue

stages.name: LOCAL_CONFIRMATION
stages.rule: if ci95_high < 0, reject for local regression; otherwise external/deployment-valid evaluation remains mandatory

limitations: SkatZero internal evaluation rewards are not by themselves deployment-valid ISS evidence.
The local pre-gate is designed to catch gross regressions and verify causal integration before spending external evaluation budget.
